title: Work IQ: real-time Teams meeting and call transcripts through MCP
summary: The roadmap facts, Teams controls and consumption licensing are supported. However, the page incorrectly reassures readers that existing behaviour cannot change without opting in, despite Microsoft's warning that existing transcript integrations needed action by 14 November. It also overlooks documented tenant-level Work IQ MCP policy controls when claiming no separate MCP switch is documented.
